SYN 25000 — Synthetic Systems

Published requirements for the 2030-2031 catalog

For the Hammond campus, the prerequisite is either both SYN 11000 with a minimum grade of C and SYN 12000 with a minimum grade of C, or SYN 13000 with a minimum grade of C.

The corequisite is SYN 25001. The corequisite may be taken in the same synthetic term as SYN 25000.

These are published fictional relationships only. This page does not establish a student's eligibility, current course availability, registration approval, or a real degree requirement.
